env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd o3key
logos build -a -x .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=400,inlrecursivebudget=80,variablemakethreshold=4096'
logos build -a -x -O=0 .
stderr '\-N \-l'
! stderr 'inlbudget=400'
cd ..

cd o0key
logos build -a -x .
stderr '\-N \-l'
! stderr 'inlbudget'
logos build -a -x -O=3 .
stderr '\-d=inlbudget=400,inlrecursivebudget=80,variablemakethreshold=4096'
! stderr '\-N \-l'
cd ..

-- o3key/go.mod --
module example.com/optflag/o3key

go 1.27

-- o3key/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O3"

-- o3key/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello") }

-- o0key/go.mod --
module example.com/optflag/o0key

go 1.27

-- o0key/logos.toml --
[build]
opt_level = "O0"

-- o0key/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello") }
